title: Amazing
body:
Wow bro I’ve only used this for a bit but it’s such a simple and easy to use app and it’s free! I will 
recommend this to everybody. The actual interface itself is so simple and clean too! Keep up the great work and I hope you find success with this amazing app 🙌
author: Shibinshax

title: THIS APP IS PERFECT
body: Well, not too much to say, the app has very good settings and I can adjust and see as much times I can do something in the day, and the graphics are good enough to have an idea about what Im doing and how’s going, and, also, no “Im app purchases”, I was looking for something like this all this time, thank you so much, and I’ll surely recommend to my friends
